Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Ensure the brand logo on the charger enclosure is not covered or obstructed. Used for automatic app profile loading.
Action Required: User: Ensure the brand logo on the charger enclosure is not covered or obstructed.

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Verify if three-phase wiring matches the 22kW charger requirements (400V±15%). Ensure all three phases (L1, L2, L3) are properly connected.
Action Required: User: Confirm system is operating on a three-phase supply line.

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Verify if single-phase wiring matches the 7kW charger requirements (230V±15%). Ensure phase-neutral configuration is correct.
Action Required: User: Confirm system is operating on a single-phase supply line. No immediate fault rectification required.

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check the isolator switch on the side of the unit.
Action Required: User: Flip switch to ON; Check whether the breaker in the EVDB has tripped.

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check for short circuit/overload. Try resetting the MCB.
Action Required: User: Isolate charger, wait 2-3 mins to cool down, attempt to reset once.

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Measure input voltage at the charger terminal (~230V or ~400V). Check if upstream MCB, RCD, or main fuse has blown.
Action Required: User: Check whether the breaker in the EVDB has tripped.

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Check e.BOX App or display for error codes (e.g., Grounding Issue, Over Current). Measure voltage and check earthing resistance (<40Ω).
Action Required: User: Screenshot the website and send to technician

Troubleshooting Steps & Parameters: Ensure the serial number sticker/plate is clean, unblurred, and completely visible to the camera for OCR scanning.
Action Required: User: Position the camera directly in front of the serial number plate. Manual input required if the text is physically damaged.
